# Copilot instructions for WSS League Desk

- Build and maintain a polished dark sports league dashboard for WHITBY SMASH SQUAD.
- Prefer original WSS branding over direct copy of the reference app.
- Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- Keep the dashboard usable for team management, standings, matches, players, and costs.
- Prefer reusable data structures and simple local mock data that can later be replaced with Supabase or a database.
- Ensure the app is deployable on Vercel with no custom server requirements.
